name: Governance debt
short_description: Governance debt describes the accumulating risk and cleanup effort that arise when AI agents and integrations are shipped without central identity, policy, logging and cost controls, trading short-term speed for long-term loss of control.

evidence.quote: the hidden costs start appearing governance-debt.
The rollout stops because AI instantly surfaces governance debt that the organization has been accumulating for years.
Governance debt is different from technical debt.
The real cost is deferred productivity plus compounding governance debt.
